title: The permits with the most stated prerequisites
question: Which permits have the longest list of things the published pages say must be done first or alongside?
finding: 52 permits or approvals have at least one stated prerequisite. Building permit: 21 (16 before); State-streamlined housing application (ministerial approval): 4 (4 before); Health permit (Public Health): 4 (2 before); Food truck permit (Public Works): 4 (4 before). The things most often required by other permits are business registration (6 permits), building permit (5 permits), planning approval (4 permits).
how: Counts of the distinct pairs in the first screen, by the permit that needs something. "Needed by" counts how many other permits name this one as a prerequisite.
limits: A long list reflects how many situations the pages describe, not what one applicant faces: the building permit list mixes requirements for landmarks, added dwelling units, cannabis lounges and large housing projects. Pages that describe a permit in more detail produce more pairs.
